verdict.rationale: Composio provides triggers that deliver connected-app events to a registered webhook (docs-9, docs-21) and supports unattended agent authentication via `composio login --agent` (docs-19/33), which together let an AI-native builder wire up event-driven automations without a human in the loop. However, Composio itself is a tool/auth layer, not an orchestration or scheduling engine — there's no evidence of a persistent background runner, cron-like scheduler, or hosted execution loop that keeps an automation running autonomously; that responsibility falls to the consuming agent/app. missing for 10: evidence of a built-in scheduler or persistent background execution engine, and independent/hands-on confirmation that trigger-based automations run reliably unattended.
